newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador inflation 2.38 pct in September.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador inflation 2.38 pct in September.

text.p: Ecuador's Consumer Price Index rose by 2.38 percent in September, down from 2.51 percent in the same month last year, the National Statistics and Census Institute said Tuesday.
Cumulative inflation for the past 12 months was 24.96 percent.
Cumulative inflation for the first nine months of 1996 was 19.4 percent, up from 17.3 percent in the same 1995 period.
The government expects to close 1996 with an inflation rate of about 23 or 24 percent.
